scripts.dev: wrangler dev -c wrangler.edge.jsonc -c wrangler.core.jsonc -c wrangler.dev-provider.jsonc --env dev
scripts.types: wrangler types -c wrangler.core.jsonc --env dev --env-file config/core-types.env --strict-vars=false --include-runtime=false --env-interface CoreEnv src/generated/core-env.d.ts && wrangler types -c wrangler.edge.jsonc --env dev --env-file .dev.vars.example --strict-vars=false --include-runtime=false --env-interface EdgeEnv src/generated/edge-env.d.ts
scripts.types:check: npm run types && git diff --exit-code -- src/generated
scripts.test: npm run test:domain && npm run test:unit
scripts.deploy:dev:dry: wrangler deploy -c wrangler.dev-provider.jsonc --env dev --dry-run && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.core.jsonc --env dev --dry-run && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.edge.jsonc --env dev --dry-run
scripts.deploy:production:dry: wrangler deploy -c wrangler.core.jsonc --env production --dry-run && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.edge.jsonc --env production --dry-run
scripts.check: npm run types:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:workers && npm run deploy:dev:dry && npm run deploy:production:dry
